rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
This is the extension zone for the city of Kir-Oshi (zone 182).
This zone includes the following areas:

	o	Liu'she Ch'uan Tong Headquarters

rooms.name: A Dimly Lit Foyer
rooms.desc:
You can barely see in the dim candlelight of this foyer, but you can 
make out dark, arched passageways which lead in all directions except 
south, where a narrow flight of stairs leads up to a reception of some 
sort.  Although this room appears to be very old, with walls made of 
rough-cut stone, it lacks a sense of decay which tells you that this area 
must see regular use.  You shudder to think by what.

rooms.name: A Dark Hallway
rooms.desc:
The limited lighting that the foyer received from the upstairs 
reception is gone now, forcing you to provide light sources of your own.  
The walls and floor here are rough-cut stone, which is cold to the touch.  
You find yourself having to walk slowly to avoid tripping on any nooks 
in the rock floor.  At first, this hallway appeared to be a mine tunnel of 
some sort, but now you notice the lack of man-made structural support.  
Whatever made this tunnel carved it through solid rock.  The passage 
turns north here, and east returns you to a dim foyer.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passageway begins to slope downward here, and continues to do 
so to the north.  You can sense that the air is cooler in that direction as 
well, but with a stale smell to it, as if the passage ahead dives deep 
underground.  The rock here is dark gray and cool to the touch, the 
passageway leads north and south into inky darkness.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The air is still and cool in this section of passageway, and the rock 
walls seem to be somewhat more smoothed out and defined than those 
walls further south of you.  There is a heavy oak door set into the 
western wall, it appears to have swelled with moisture, as evidenced by 
the poor condition of its iron bindings. You might be able to force it 
though.  The passage leads north and south into inky blackness.

rooms.name: A Training Area
rooms.desc:
The floor here is lit by braziers sunk into the rock floor, which seems 
abnormally smooth in comparison to the earlier sections of the 
complex.  This is apparently where the Liu'she Ch'uan tong practices 
their martial arts skills - in fact, some tong members appear to be 
practicing them right now...

rooms.name: A Training Area
rooms.desc:
There is a large red mat made of out some type of heavy cloth spread 
out on the ground here, and many weapons line the walls.  You surmise 
that this area is used by the tong to train their initiates in weapons use.  
Gazing at the vast arsenal of hand-to-hand weaponry, you realize that 
these are not merely training weapons, these are the real thing!  
Suddenly, you remember the cloth mat underneath your feet.  With 
horror, you realize that you now know why it is colored red.

rooms.name: A Training Area
rooms.desc:
This room looks like it was once used for storage, but now the boxes 
and other bulky items have been moved next to the walls, and the center 
of the room cleared for sparring matches.  There is a thin cloth sheet 
covering the doorway to the room south, and you can see the glow of 
many candles from within.  The training area continues to the north.

rooms.name: A Meditation Room
rooms.desc:
One of the Liu'she Ch'uan ideologies is that one must have a clear 
and focused mind to be a great warrior, and thus focus part of their 
training in meditative skills.  As you enter the room however, you 
realize that these students are more interested in doing what they do 
best, which in this case would mean killing you.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passage makes a corner here, running from south to east.  You 
hear noises, but due to the echoing in the tunnels it is hard to tell the 
source or the nature of them.  Some sound like footsteps, some like faint 
mumbled voices, but they are all too indistinct to make out.  The air has 
a stale, clammy feel to it, making you realize you must be pretty deep 
underground.  The passage leads into inky blackness to the north and 
west.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance of a long hallway that seems to extend 
straight in front of you.  It is, however, completely dark here, with no 
torches on the walls, and so you find yourself stumbling about on the 
nooks in the rough cut stone floor as you attempt to walk in semi-
darkness.  The walls here seem to be made of cut stone that has been 
smoothed and polished.  You notice that they are cool to the touch.  
There is also a chamber directly to your south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
Wandering down this hallway, you notice that the air here seems to 
be cooler and slightly stale.  There is also a dampness and moisture on 
the walls that seems to indicate the presence of water somewhere 
nearby.  Could this passage actually extend out underneath the ocean?  
The passageway extends into darkness to your north and south.

rooms.name: An Intersection
rooms.desc:
This is a T-intersection in a labyrinth of cool, dark passageways. 
Tunnels to the west, south, and east lead into darkness, while there is a 
heavy iron-bound oak door to your north.  The dampness in these 
passages has caused the oak to swell in the door frame, leaving it 
cracked and blistered.  It has also managed to rust the iron bindings, the 
heavy iron knocker, and the iron keyhole. Cool, still air hangs heavily 
around you.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passageway seems to even out here, continuing west and east into 
utter darkness.  To the south, there is a heavy looking iron door.  The 
doorframe for it has a moderately high lip on it, as if it were designed to 
keep liquid from the other side of the door from entering this passage.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passageway makes a sharp corner here, turning into another 
passage and even more darkness.  You notice that the passage slopes 
downward slightly to the north and west, the still, clammy air hangs 
about your person.  The passages continue in darkness to your south 
and west.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You stumble about in the darkness of this cold, black passageway 
occasionally bumping into the rough-hewn stone walls.  You also notice 
that there is some sort of linear impression in the stone floor, like 
treads.  Its almost as if something very heavy had been pushed back and 
forth over this floor many times. 
The passage continues to your north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You stare off into seemingly infinite darkness as you attempt to 
navigate down this tunnel, the side walls and floor barely illuminated 
by your light.  The cold, damp air is beginning to press against you, its 
staleness heavy on your nostrils.  There must be virtually no circulation 
down here.  The passage continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
The passage here curves to run west to north, and you almost don't 
see the change in topography and nearly run smack into a wall. You 
notice that the passage seems to slope downward to the north, while it 
seems to open up slightly to the west.  You notice that there are no 
cobwebs or signs of any non-humanoid life at all, perhaps the cold air 
keeps all the insects and animals away.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
This is a somewhat open passage that leads eastward into complete 
darkness.  To the west, dim candlelight beckons you out into what 
appears to be a larger chamber.  The air here is very calm, as if it has 
been undisturbed for ages, but the lack of musty smell tells you that that 
cannot be so.  In what little light there is, you think you can make out 
what appears to be parallel grooves in the rough stone floor that lead 
into darkness to the east.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a massively cavernous room whose expanse opens 
up before you to the north.  This place seems to defy logic, what would 
a room as big as this be doing under here?  The walls are smooth, 
polished stone and extend up into darkness; you can barely make out 
the cathedral ceiling at the top.  In the centre of the room two massive 
stone pillars also extend to support the ceiling, their buttresses the only 
hint that they connect with it.  You deduce that you indeed must be far 
underground, because a room this high would be impossible at any 
other altitude except for one below sea level.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You are directly in front of one of the stone columns here.  From this 
vantage point you can see most of the goings on in this huge room.  
This is apparently the centre of operations for the Liu'she Ch'uan Tong 
-- a sophisticated group of thieves, assassins, and smugglers.  The room 
extends to your west and east, your passage south being blocked by the 
stone wall of the room, and the north blocked by the column.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the southeast corner of the room, your view of the rest of the 
room is concealed by the massive stone pillar which is now to your 
direct northwest.
It is very, very dark here. Is there something moving in the shadows?

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in the shadow of one of the massive columns in this room, 
which is just to your west. Various shady characters are moving around 
in here, going about the secret business of the Tong.  Perhaps it would 
be best if you stayed concealed.  You are concealed, aren't you?

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the northeast corner of the this massive room.  Many men in 
exotic clothes walk around here, obviously high ranking Tong 
members.  There are also many men clothed completely in black, 
sharpening weapons. Obviously they are high ranking Tong assassins.  
Obviously, you probably shouldn't be here.  The room continues to your 
west and south.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You are now just south of the leftmost pillar in this massive room.  To 
your west, important looking Tong members in elaborate clothes 
discuss something in whispers.  The way to your west is lighted with 
braziers, to your east there is only darkness.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the back centre of the entire cavern, the walls sweep upwards 
to your north, and the two stone columns frame the room to the south.  
This section of the room is well lit and furnished, and several tall 
oriental men dressed in elaborate clothing sit here smoking and 
discussing something in a language you do not know.  They seem 
unaware of your presence, as if preoccupied by something else.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
The light in this section of the room is almost nonexistant, blocked by 
one of the giant stone columns directly to your south.  There seems to 
be quite a lot of light just to your east however.  You could walk over 
there or to the west, where the corner of the room blends into darkness.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the northwestern corner of this immense room.  There is 
virtually no light here at all, and you find yourself maneuvering around 
figures in the near darkness -- who knows what they might be doing 
here.  The room continues around the pillar to your east, and also to 
your south.  The air here is very still, and you can hear people 
whispering in the darkness in a language you don't comprehend.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand just west of the leftmost column in this massive cavern.
The walls sweep upward into blackness to your west.  The columns and
black stone walls absorb what little light there is in here, making it
very difficult to see, even with your own light sources.  The cavern
continues to your north and south.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
The pillar to your northeast shields you from virtually all of the light
sources in this cavernous room, and the flat black stone that makes up
the wall to your south and west does its part in absorbing your own
light sources.  This room expands to your north and east.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
You stand just to the east of the doorway into this massive cavern, 
black stone walls sweep up behind you into darkness.  One of the 
massive pillars that no doubt support the ceiling of this structure is 
directly to your north, obscuring what little light there is in this room.  
You can walk either east to the door or west into a darkened corner.

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
This room is completely damp, dominated in its centre by a perfectly 
circular surface pool.  The pool glows slightly, you suspect because it 
has been lit from underneath.  The large amount of open water in this 
room has caused significant amounts of moisture to accumulate on the 
stone walls and floor, making walking around quite a challenge.  This 
pool must be how the Tong smuggles black market goods into Kir-Oshi.  
It must lead out to the harbor somehow.

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
As you continue around this room, you notice that the floor is really 
rather slick; you should watch you step so that you don't fall head first 
into the pool with all your armor on.  Looking into the pool you notice 
that it is indeed lit from the bottom by two caged light sources.  It also 
appears to turn into an underwater tunnel of sorts several feet below the 
surface.  The tong must have some sort of device to transport black 
market goods under the water and bring them here.  You notice several 
mechanical apparatus to your south, perhaps they have something to do 
with the actual transportation of the goods?

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
There is a mechanical winch and metal chain coiled loosely on the 
ground here, as well as some other mechanical apparatus whose 
purpose you do not immediately recognize.  You surmise that this series 
of hand operated winches and chains is designed to pull something 
heavy out of the pool.  All of this machinery looks slightly rusted, 
having been exposed to these damp conditions for awhile it seems.  The 
pool continues around the room to your west and north.

rooms.name: By A Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
There are two metal hooks drilled into the floor here at the edge of 
the pool, on closer inspection you find that they attach a rope ladder 
with wooden rungs to the floor here.  The ladder extends down the side 
of the pool wall, hanging loosely against it.  There appears to be a large 
winch and some other machinery just to your east, and to your north 
there is the entrance to this room.  You suppose that you could also go 
down into the pool, but the water looks pretty cold.

rooms.name: In the Surface Pool
rooms.desc:
Brrrrr! The water IS cold! And it appears very deep as well.  You can 
just about hover on the surface, but your attempts to dive down deep 
and inspect the tunnel fail -- you just can't hold your breath long 
enough.  You can get on to dry land by swimming over to that ladder 
again, as every other shelf around this circular pool is too high for you 
to pull yourself out on.  Aside from the fact that you can see in the 
water pretty clearly because of the two caged lights just underneath you, 
there really isn't anything else interesting here.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
As you continue to feel your way down this stale, musty passageway 
you notice that the passage seems to be sloping downward to the north 
ever so slightly.  The stone that makes up the passageway seems to be 
changing as well, from soft limestone to a harder, slick stone, possibly 
granite.  You must be further underground that you previously thought.  
The passage continues into blackness to your north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are definitely further underground than you were before; the air 
here feels like it hasn't been disturbed for a century or more, yet there is 
no dust, no cobwebs.  No evidence of life at all, as near as you can tell.  
Only blackness perfected.  The cold stone passage continues to the 
north and south, with no trace of an ending.

rooms.name: A Dark Passageway
rooms.desc:
This section of the passage slants downward to the north at a 
noticeable angle.  The walls here seem to be smoother than the ones to 
the south, as if the texture of the cut rock was changing.  In fact, the 
walls and floor are noticeably slick, as if moisture had accumulated on 
them.  The stale air in the passage doesn't feel like it carries any water 
at all however.  The passage continues in darkness to the north and 
south.

rooms.name: A Cavernous Room
rooms.desc:
This is the centre of the massive cavern, situated between the two
cyclopean pillars.  The lights you possess seem unnaturally dim in the vast
blackness of this room, it seems to stretch on forever in the edges where
your light can not reach.  Shadowy figures move about in the darkness,
speaking an unmistakably foreign language.  There seems to be a bit of light
to the north, which appears to be the nexus of activity.
